title: remove_interaction inputSchema
description: Argument shape for remove_interaction (interactivity profile, ADR-0030). Removes one declarative event→action binding, by id, from a Map or App document. Target addressing matches bind_interaction: a Map or App document (mapId or appId) at the standard level, with the reference implementation's draft-lifecycle spelling (draftId + generation) admitted as x-honua-reference-shape. Removing an unknown interactionId is an error, not a no-op. See docs/adr/0030-declarative-interactions-and-layout.md. Exactly one target must be supplied: mapId, appId, or the x-honua-reference-shape draftId (which requires generation). The oneOf below enforces that; without it a call with no target, with both package ids, or with draftId and no generation validated against a contract no server can route.

mapId.description: Target Map document. Exactly one of mapId / appId / draftId identifies the target.

appId.description: Target App document. Exactly one of mapId / appId / draftId identifies the target.

draftId.description: x-honua-reference-shape: reference-implementation draft-lifecycle target. Requires generation.

generation.description: x-honua-reference-shape: optimistic-concurrency generation of the draft being mutated; the call fails on generation conflict.

interactionId.description: Id of the interaction to remove.
